sound.automixHint: Blends each song into the next, in time with the beat.
sound.transitionSmartHint: Smart listens to how each song ends: a long fade gets a long blend, a hard stop a quick one, lined up on the bar.

sound.levellingHint: Plays songs at an even loudness, from Ether's measurements.
sound.levelling.offHint: Everything plays at its own level.
sound.levelling.smartHint: Album levelling while an album plays in order, so its quiet songs stay quiet; track levelling for shuffle, playlists and radio.
sound.levelling.trackHint: Every song at the same loudness.
sound.levelling.albumHint: Every album at the same loudness, its songs as they were mastered.
sound.preventClippingHint: Never turns anything up so far that its loudest moment distorts.
sound.nowUnmeasured: Not measured yet: it plays at its own level until it has been played once.
sound.unavailable: This server doesn't send loudness yet, so everything plays at its own level.
sound.eqHint: Shapes the sound for your speakers or headphones.

sound.spokenNote: Books and episodes always play straight through, without AutoMix.
sound.levellingSpokenHint: Plays every book and episode at an even loudness, from Ether's measurements.
sound.levelling.spokenOnHint: A book's parts keep their balance with each other; each episode is levelled on its own.
